== Silver Flame Trinket ==
* {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}
* [[Exclusive]]
* A small item given to you by [[Jakob Izakanos]]. Its powers will increase when used at a sacred altar in the end-crypt of any of [[The Necropolis|the Necropolis]] chains.

Note: Despite the word "[[Trinket]]" in the name, it cannot be equipped until [[Silver Flame Nugget|upgraded]], and then it becomes a '''[[necklace]]'''.
